title: Lately I've seen lots of...
content_text:
Lately I've seen lots of regular Chinese people posting videos on YouTube — all of them vlog their daily life in broken English.
Honestly, it kind of inspired me, but it also made me feel a bit ashamed that I don't have the guts to do something like that.
Yeah, that's the TTS transcription messing up my pronunciation — some words got transcribed as other words.
Like I said "unfluently" but it wrote "unfriendly". Can you add that to the AGENTS.md so it handles it?
Don't over-encourage me — I just want the truth and the gap.
Add this principle to the AGENTS.md.
I decided to do some push-ups just now, and I did them — but I was a bit disappointed I only managed 20, even though I gave it my best effort.
